title.en: Client advocacy for a capacitated older adult refusing PEG placement
title.zh: 为有决策能力且拒绝 PEG 置管的老年患者进行护理倡导

summary.en: An 82-year-old client with end-stage heart failure, progressive dysphagia, and poor oral intake refuses PEG tube placement after an informed discussion. Her adult children pressure the team to proceed, and her son claims authority under a DPOAHC that activates only if she loses decisional capacity.
summary.zh: 一名 82 岁患者患有终末期心力衰竭、进行性吞咽困难和进食不足。在充分知情沟通后，她拒绝放置 PEG 管。她的成年子女要求医疗团队继续置管，其儿子声称自己可根据医疗保健持久授权书（DPOAHC）作决定，但该授权仅在患者丧失决策能力时才生效。

content.en:
Patient: Margaret Ellison, 82 years old.
Admitted from home with NYHA class IV heart-failure exacerbation, worsening dyspnea, edema, and poor oral intake for 5 days.
History: ischemic cardiomyopathy with EF 15%, CKD stage 4 with baseline creatinine 2.8 mg/dL, type 2 diabetes on basal insulin, progressive dysphagia followed by speech-language pathology for 6 months. Three hospitalizations in the past 4 months for fluid overload. Outpatient palliative-care referral was recently canceled by family.
Advance directive: son David is named durable power of attorney for health care, to be activated only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Current orders: IV furosemide 40 mg every 12 hr, fluid restriction 1,200 mL/day, low-sodium cardiac diet with pureed foods and nectar-thick liquids per speech-language pathology, daily weights, telemetry.
Initial statement to admitting nurse: "I don't want any more tubes or machines. I've had a good life. I want to be comfortable."
Initial assessment: alert, conversational, oriented to person/place/time/situation. Mini-Cog 4/5. Mood calm and reflective; denies depression or hopelessness and states she feels "at peace." Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 92 irregular, BP 104/62, RR 22, SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula. Weight 68.4 kg; documented dry weight 64.2 kg. Bilateral lower-lung crackles, JVD at 45 degrees, 3+ bilateral pitting edema to mid-shin, temporal wasting. Oral mucosa moist. She can manage small sips of nectar-thick water but needs prolonged time to initiate swallowing.
Admission labs: BNP 2,840 pg/mL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 5.1 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 3.2 mg/dL, eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2, glucose 142 mg/dL, albumin 2.6 g/dL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, INR 1.1, prealbumin 11 mg/dL.
content.zh:
患者：Margaret Ellison，82 岁。
因 NYHA IV 级心力衰竭加重从家中入院，过去 5 天出现气促加重、水肿和进食不足。
病史：缺血性心肌病，射血分数 15%；慢性肾病 4 期，基线肌酐 2.8 mg/dL；2 型糖尿病，使用基础胰岛素；进行性吞咽困难，过去 6 个月由言语语言病理科随访。过去 4 个月因液体负荷过多住院 3 次。近期曾转诊门诊姑息治疗，但被家属取消。
预立医疗指示：儿子 David 被指定为医疗保健持久授权代理人，但只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。
现有医嘱：呋塞米 40 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；限液 1,200 mL/日；低钠心脏饮食，按言语语言病理科建议给予糊状食物和花蜜稠液；每日体重；遥测监护。
入院时对护士的表述：“我不想再要任何管子或机器了。我这一生过得很好。我想舒服一点。”
初始评估：清醒、能交谈，人物、地点、时间和情境定向力均正常。Mini-Cog 4/5。情绪平静、能反思；否认抑郁或绝望，并表示自己“很平静”。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92 次/分且不规则，BP 104/62，RR 22 次/分，SpO2 93%，经鼻导管吸氧 2 L/min。体重 68.4 kg；记录的干体重 64.2 kg。双下肺湿啰音，45 度可见颈静脉怒张，双下肢至小腿中段 3+ 凹陷性水肿，颞部消瘦。口腔黏膜湿润。可少量饮用花蜜稠水，但启动吞咽时间延长。
入院实验室：BNP 2,840 pg/mL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 5.1 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐 3.2 mg/dL，eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2，血糖 142 mg/dL，白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，Hgb 9.8 g/dL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，INR 1.1，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

title.zh: 阶段 1：住院第 1 天下午

content.en:
The attending physician discusses progressive dysphagia and poor nutritional status with the family and recommends PEG tube placement to maintain nutrition and hydration. Mrs. Ellison listens to the explanation and asks, "Will the tube cure my heart?" and "Will I still be able to eat anything by mouth?" She then states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
Physician documentation: "Patient demonstrates understanding of risks and benefits of PEG placement, including that PEG does not necessarily eliminate aspiration risk, and continued weight loss without it. She articulates her values and reasoning clearly. Decision-making capacity intact. Patient declines PEG at this time."
Son David tells the nurse: "She doesn't know what she's saying. She's old and she's giving up. You need to talk some sense into her. I'm her power of attorney — I want the tube placed." Daughter Karen calls and says, "My brother and I agree. We want everything done. She's just scared. Can't you convince her?" The nurse confirms that the advance directive activates the son's authority only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Vitals: HR 88, BP 108/64, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.8 kg. She is resting comfortably, tolerating small amounts of pureed food and nectar-thick liquids. Telemetry: atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular rate.
content.zh:
主治医师与家属讨论患者进行性吞咽困难和营养状况不佳，并建议放置 PEG 管以维持营养和水分。Ellison 太太听完解释后问：“这个管子能治好我的心脏吗？”以及“我以后还能不能吃一点东西？”随后她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”
医师记录：“患者表现出理解 PEG 置管风险与获益的能力，包括 PEG 不一定能消除误吸风险，以及不置管可能继续体重下降。她能清楚表达自己的价值观和理由。决策能力完整。患者此时拒绝 PEG。”
儿子 David 对护士说：“她不知道自己在说什么。她老了，只是在放弃。你们要劝醒她。我是她的授权代理人——我要放这个管子。” 女儿 Karen 打电话到病区说：“我和我哥哥意见一致。我们希望什么都做。她只是害怕。你不能说服她吗？” 护士确认预立医疗指示规定：只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时，儿子的代理权才生效。
生命体征：HR 88 次/分，BP 108/64，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.8 kg。患者安静休息，可少量耐受糊状食物和花蜜稠液。遥测：心房颤动，心室率受控。

title.zh: 阶段 2：住院第 2 天上午

content.en:
David again tells the attending physician that nobody is listening to the family. The physician privately tells the nurse, "The family is really upset. Maybe we should just schedule the PEG consult and see if she changes her mind once GI comes by. It might calm things down."
The nurse reassesses Mrs. Ellison. She remains alert, oriented, calm, and states without prompting: "I told the doctor yesterday. No tube. I want to go home and be comfortable. I've thought about this for months — this isn't a snap decision." She adds, "My children mean well, but this is my body and my life." When asked about pressure or coercion, she states, "David keeps coming in and telling me I'm being selfish. It upsets me, but it doesn't change my mind." She asks the nurse, "Will you make sure they respect what I want?"
Vitals: HR 90, BP 100/60, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.2 kg. She ate about 30% of pureed breakfast. BNP 2,410 pg/mL, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, K 5.3 mEq/L, Na 130 mEq/L.
content.zh:
David 再次告诉主治医师，认为没有人听家属意见。医师私下对护士说：“家属真的很不高兴。也许我们可以先安排 PEG 会诊，等胃肠科来看后再看看她会不会改变主意。这样可能能让事情平静下来。”
护士重新评估 Ellison 太太。她仍然清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静，并主动说：“我昨天已经告诉医生了。不要管子。我想回家，舒服一点。这件事我已经想了好几个月——不是一时冲动的决定。” 她又说：“我的孩子们是好意，但这是我的身体、我的人生。” 护士询问她是否受到压力或胁迫，她说：“David 一直进来，说我自私。这让我难过，但不会改变我的想法。” 她问护士：“你能确保他们尊重我的意愿吗？”
生命体征：HR 90 次/分，BP 100/60，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.2 kg。糊状早餐约吃了 30%。BNP 2,410 pg/mL，肌酐 3.4 mg/dL，K 5.3 mEq/L，Na 130 mEq/L。

title.zh: 阶段 3：住院第 2 天傍晚
护理倡导措施及姑息治疗评估

content.en:
The nurse has documented Mrs. Ellison's repeated, consistent refusal with direct quotes and capacity observations; informed the charge nurse of the ethical concern; requested palliative care; and arranged a family meeting for the next morning with the attending physician, palliative care team, social worker, and both adult children. David states he has contacted a lawyer and "will get a court order" to have the PEG placed.
Mrs. Ellison is resting and tells the nurse she is glad someone is listening to her. She asks about hospice options at home. Vitals: HR 86, BP 102/58, RR 18, SpO2 95% on 2 L. Weight 66.8 kg. She tolerated small amounts of pureed lunch. Telemetry unchanged.
Palliative-care nurse practitioner note: "Mrs. Ellison demonstrates intact decisional capacity, consistent values-based reasoning, and an informed, voluntary refusal of PEG tube placement. Recommend goals-of-care meeting with family, comfort-focused plan of care, and hospice referral per patient's expressed wishes."
content.zh:
护士已在护理记录中记录 Ellison 太太反复且一致的拒绝，包括直接引语和决策能力相关观察；已告知护士长存在伦理问题；已申请姑息治疗；并安排次日上午由主治医师、姑息治疗团队、社工和两名成年子女参加家庭会议。David 表示他已联系律师，并“会拿到法院命令”要求放置 PEG。
Ellison 太太正在休息，并告诉护士，很高兴有人在听她说话。她询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。生命体征：HR 86 次/分，BP 102/58，RR 18 次/分，SpO2 95%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 66.8 kg。午餐少量糊状食物可耐受。遥测无变化。
姑息治疗护士执业者记录：“Ellison 太太表现出完整的决策能力，基于一致价值观进行推理，并对 PEG 置管作出知情、自愿的拒绝。建议与家属进行照护目标会议，制定以舒适为重点的照护计划，并根据患者明确表达的意愿转介临终关怀。”

stem.en: Stage 1: Highlight the findings that establish that Mrs. Ellison's refusal is the governing decision.
stem.zh: 阶段 1：请标出哪些发现能确立 Ellison 太太的拒绝是当前应遵循的决定。

segments.en: The physician documents that Mrs. Ellison understands the risks and benefits of PEG placement, including continued weight loss without it.
segments.zh: 医师记录 Ellison 太太理解 PEG 置管的风险与获益，包括不置管可能继续体重下降。

segments.en: She asks clarifying questions about whether the tube will cure her heart failure and whether she may still eat by mouth.
segments.zh: 她提出澄清性问题，询问管子是否能治愈心力衰竭，以及是否仍可经口进食。

segments.en: She states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
segments.zh: 她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”

segments.en: The advance directive states that the son's DPOAHC authority activates only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
segments.zh: 预立医疗指示说明，儿子的 DPOAHC 权限只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。

segments.en: Mini-Cog score is 4/5 with a normal clock draw.
David says he is the power of attorney and wants the tube placed.
segments.zh: David 说自己是授权代理人，并要求放置管子。

segments.en: Albumin is 2.6 g/dL and prealbumin is 11 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

segments.en: Speech-language pathology has followed progressive dysphagia for 6 months.
segments.zh: 言语语言病理科已随访进行性吞咽困难 6 个月。

correct.en: The governing cues are decision-specific capacity documentation, Mrs. Ellison's demonstrated understanding and clarifying questions, her clear values-based refusal, and the advance directive clause showing that the son's surrogate authority is dormant while she has capacity.
correct.zh: 关键线索是：针对 PEG 决定的能力评估记录、患者表现出理解并提出澄清问题、她清楚且基于价值观地拒绝，以及预立医疗指示说明只要她仍有能力，儿子的代理权就尚未生效。

byChoice.en: This directly supports decision-specific capacity because it documents understanding of risks and benefits.
byChoice.zh: 这直接支持针对该决定的决策能力，因为记录了她理解风险与获益。

byChoice.en: Clarifying questions show that she is engaging with the information rather than passively refusing.
byChoice.zh: 提出澄清问题说明她在主动理解信息，而不是被动拒绝。

byChoice.en: This is the patient's own informed, values-based refusal, which governs while she has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 这是患者本人知情且基于价值观的拒绝；只要她有能力，该决定就应被遵循。

byChoice.en: The activation clause shows that the son does not currently have decision-making authority.
byChoice.zh: 生效条件说明儿子目前没有代替患者作决定的权力。

byChoice.en: A normal cognitive screen supports the absence of an obvious red flag, but it does not by itself establish legal decision-making authority for this PEG decision.
byChoice.zh: 认知筛查正常可提示没有明显认知警讯，但不能单独确立患者对 PEG 决定的法律决策能力。

byChoice.en: The son's claim is a cue to check the document, not proof that his authority has activated.
byChoice.zh: 儿子的说法提示护士应核对文件，但不能证明他的代理权已经生效。

byChoice.en: These nutritional labs support why PEG is being recommended; they do not determine who has consent authority.
byChoice.zh: 这些营养指标支持为什么会建议 PEG，但不能决定谁有同意或拒绝的权力。

byChoice.en: Dysphagia supports the clinical rationale for discussing PEG but does not override a capacitated refusal.
byChoice.zh: 吞咽困难支持讨论 PEG 的医学理由，但不能推翻有决策能力患者的拒绝。

testTakingStrategy.en: For capacity and consent questions, key the findings that show understanding, reasoning, voluntariness, and who legally holds authority now—not the findings that make the proposed treatment medically reasonable.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到决策能力和同意权题目时，优先寻找能证明理解、推理、自愿性以及当前谁有法律权力的线索，而不是只看治疗在医学上是否合理。

stem.en: Stage 1: David insists that his DPOAHC status allows him to override his mother's refusal and request PEG placement. Whose decision governs at this time?
stem.zh: 阶段 1：David 坚称自己的 DPOAHC 身份允许他推翻母亲的拒绝并要求放置 PEG。此时应遵循谁的决定？

options.en: The decision should be delayed until Mrs. Ellison's daughter can be physically present.
options.zh: 应推迟决定，直到 Ellison 太太的女儿能亲自到场。

options.en: Mrs. Ellison's refusal governs because her decision-making capacity is intact and documented.
options.zh: 应遵循 Ellison 太太的拒绝，因为她的决策能力完整且已有记录。

options.en: David's decision governs because a DPOAHC always has priority over the patient's current choice.
options.zh: 应遵循 David 的决定，因为 DPOAHC 总是优先于患者当前选择。

options.en: The physician may proceed because PEG placement is medically recommended for poor intake and dysphagia.
options.zh: 医师可以继续安排，因为 PEG 对进食不足和吞咽困难有医学建议理由。

options.en: The children should decide together because both adult children agree with PEG placement.
options.zh: 应由两名成年子女共同决定，因为他们都同意 PEG 置管。

correct.en: A capacitated adult holds the authority to accept or refuse treatment. The DPOAHC is meaningful but dormant because the activation condition—loss of decisional capacity—has not occurred.
correct.zh: 有决策能力的成年人有权接受或拒绝治疗。DPOAHC 文件本身有法律意义，但由于触发生效条件——丧失决策能力——尚未发生，因此目前尚未生效。

byChoice.en: A DPOAHC does not override the current decision of a capacitated patient.
byChoice.zh: DPOAHC 不能推翻有决策能力患者当前作出的决定。

byChoice.en: This correctly applies autonomy and the documented capacity assessment.
byChoice.zh: 这正确应用了自主原则和已记录的决策能力评估。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the daughter is unnecessary because the patient has already made an informed decision and can speak for herself.
byChoice.zh: 无需等待女儿到场，因为患者已作出知情决定，并能为自己表达意愿。

byChoice.en: Family agreement does not create authority over a capacitated adult's treatment refusal.
byChoice.zh: 家属意见一致并不会赋予他们推翻有能力成年患者拒绝治疗的权力。

byChoice.en: Medical recommendation is not a substitute for consent when the patient has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 当患者有决策能力时，医学建议不能替代患者同意。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let the phrase 'power of attorney' automatically shift authority away from a patient. Ask whether the patient currently lacks capacity and whether the document is activated.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要因为看到“授权代理人”就自动把决定权从患者身上转移。先判断患者当前是否无能力，以及文件是否已经生效。

stem.en: Stage 2: The physician suggests scheduling the PEG consult anyway to calm the family. What is the nurse's priority ethical obligation?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：医师建议仍先安排 PEG 会诊以安抚家属。护士最优先的伦理职责是什么？

options.en: Advocate for Mrs. Ellison's informed, voluntary refusal so it is not overridden by family pressure or provider ambivalence.
options.zh: 为 Ellison 太太知情、自愿的拒绝进行倡导，防止其意愿被家属压力或医师摇摆态度覆盖。

options.en: Prioritize correcting malnutrition because albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先纠正营养不良，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

options.en: Schedule the consult because allowing GI to speak with her is a neutral way to keep the family calm.
options.zh: 安排会诊，因为让胃肠科与她谈谈是一种中立方式，也能让家属平静。

options.en: Tell the family the nurse cannot discuss the situation and avoid further contact with them.
options.zh: 告诉家属护士不能讨论此事，并避免继续接触他们。

options.en: Stay neutral and let the physician and family resolve the disagreement without nursing involvement.
options.zh: 保持中立，让医师和家属自行解决分歧，护士不介入。

correct.en: The immediate ethical risk is that the patient's autonomous refusal may be undermined. Nursing advocacy means protecting the patient's voice, while still addressing family distress through appropriate interdisciplinary support.
correct.zh: 当前最直接的伦理风险是患者自主拒绝可能被削弱。护理倡导意味着保护患者的声音，同时通过合适的跨专业支持处理家属痛苦。

byChoice.en: The family deserves compassionate communication and support; avoidance does not protect the patient or resolve the conflict.
byChoice.zh: 家属仍需要同理沟通和支持；回避既不能保护患者，也不能解决冲突。

byChoice.en: Nursing neutrality in the face of an autonomy threat becomes a failure to advocate.
byChoice.zh: 当患者自主权受到威胁时，护士所谓“中立”会变成未履行倡导职责。

byChoice.en: This centers the capacitated patient's right to refuse treatment and addresses the actual threat in Stage 2.
byChoice.zh: 这把有能力患者拒绝治疗的权利放在中心，并回应了阶段 2 的真正威胁。

byChoice.en: A consult requested as a pressure tactic after refusal is not neutral; it may undermine autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者已拒绝后，为施压或安抚家属而安排会诊并不中立，可能削弱自主权。

byChoice.en: The nutritional problem is real, but a clinical problem does not override informed refusal.
byChoice.zh: 营养问题确实存在，但临床问题不能推翻知情拒绝。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several concerns compete, identify what is being threatened right now. Here, the threat is not malnutrition alone; it is loss of the patient's autonomous choice.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题竞争优先级时，要找出当前正在受威胁的是什么。本题中受威胁的不只是营养状态，而是患者自主选择权。

stem.en: Stage 2: Which nursing actions are appropriate to uphold Mrs. Ellison's wishes and address the family conflict? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：哪些护理措施适合用于维护 Ellison 太太的意愿并处理家属冲突？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Communicate directly with the physician that scheduling a PEG consult over the documented refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 直接与医师沟通：在已有拒绝记录的情况下安排 PEG 会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Confirm with Mrs. Ellison that her decision remains informed and voluntary and assess whether pressure has affected her choice.
options.zh: 与 Ellison 太太确认其决定仍是知情且自愿的，并评估压力是否影响了她的选择。

options.en: Encourage Mrs. Ellison to meet with GI and reconsider PEG placement for her family's sake.
options.zh: 鼓励 Ellison 太太为了家属而见胃肠科医师并重新考虑 PEG 置管。

options.en: Document her repeated refusal with direct quotes and nursing observations of alertness, orientation, calm affect, and values-based reasoning.
options.zh: 记录她反复拒绝的内容，包括直接引语，以及护士观察到的清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静和基于价值观的推理。

options.en: Defer to David's demand because he holds the DPOAHC document and is threatening escalation.
options.zh: 因为 David 持有 DPOAHC 文件且威胁升级，所以听从他的要求。

options.en: Request palliative-care/social-work support and help arrange a structured family meeting with Mrs. Ellison's consent and participation as she desires.
options.zh: 申请姑息治疗和社工支持，并在 Ellison 太太同意且愿意参与的情况下协助安排结构化家庭会议。

correct.en: Appropriate advocacy is coordinated: reassess voluntariness, document clearly, address the physician's plan directly, and bring in palliative care, social work, and a family meeting to support goals-of-care clarification without pressuring the patient.
correct.zh: 适当的倡导是多方面协调进行的：重新评估自愿性，清楚记录，直接处理医师拟安排会诊的问题，并引入姑息治疗、社工和家庭会议，在不施压患者的前提下澄清照护目标。

byChoice.en: The DPOAHC is not activated while the patient has capacity; legal threats do not transfer authority to the son.
byChoice.zh: 患者有能力时 DPOAHC 尚未生效；法律威胁不会把决定权转移给儿子。

byChoice.en: Clear documentation protects the patient's stated wishes and creates an accurate record of capacity-related observations.
byChoice.zh: 清楚记录可保护患者明确表达的意愿，并准确记录与能力相关的观察。

byChoice.en: Interdisciplinary support helps address family distress while keeping the patient's goals central.
byChoice.zh: 跨专业支持有助于处理家属痛苦，同时保持患者目标居于中心。

byChoice.en: Direct communication addresses the immediate risk that the consult may be placed despite refusal.
byChoice.zh: 直接沟通可处理会诊可能在患者拒绝后仍被安排的即时风险。

byChoice.en: Ongoing assessment of voluntariness is appropriate because family pressure is present.
byChoice.zh: 由于存在家属压力，持续评估决定是否自愿是适当的。

byChoice.en: This turns the nurse into an agent of family pressure and undermines the patient's autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 这会让护士变成家属压力的执行者，并削弱患者自主权。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA advocacy items, select actions that protect the patient, create a record, communicate up the chain, and use team resources. Eliminate actions that persuade, pressure, or defer to the wrong decision-maker.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做多选倡导题时，选择能保护患者、形成记录、向上沟通并使用团队资源的措施。排除劝说、施压或把决定权交给错误对象的措施。

stem.en: Stage 2: After reassessing Mrs. Ellison and confirming that she remains alert, informed, voluntary, and consistent in refusing PEG placement, what is the nurse's first advocacy action?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：护士重新评估 Ellison 太太，并确认她仍然清醒、知情、自愿且一致地拒绝 PEG 置管后，第一项倡导行动应是什么？

options.en: Finish documenting the refusal first and wait to speak with the physician after the family meeting is arranged.
options.zh: 先完成拒绝记录，等家庭会议安排好后再与医师沟通。

options.en: Ask David to bring the DPOAHC paperwork to the unit before taking further action.
options.zh: 先请 David 把 DPOAHC 文件带到病区，再采取进一步行动。

options.en: Respectfully tell the physician without delay that Mrs. Ellison again declined PEG placement, capacity is documented, and scheduling the consult over refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 立即且尊重地告知医师：Ellison 太太再次拒绝 PEG，决策能力已有记录，在其拒绝后仍安排会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Call the ethics committee first before addressing the concern with the physician.
options.zh: 先联系伦理委员会，再与医师处理此问题。

options.en: Ask Mrs. Ellison whether she will agree to a one-time GI consult so the family can feel reassured.
options.zh: 询问 Ellison 太太是否愿意接受一次胃肠科会诊，好让家属安心。

correct.en: The physician's proposed consult is the proximate threat to autonomy. The nurse should use clear structured communication to stop the consult from being placed over the patient's refusal and recommend palliative care and a family meeting instead.
correct.zh: 医师拟安排会诊是当前最直接威胁患者自主权的因素。护士应使用清楚、有结构的沟通，防止在患者拒绝后仍安排会诊，并建议转向姑息治疗和家庭会议。

byChoice.en: Reintroducing the consult to reassure the family can become coercive after the patient has clearly refused.
byChoice.zh: 患者明确拒绝后，为安抚家属再次提出会诊可能形成胁迫。

byChoice.en: The chart already states the DPOAHC activation condition, and waiting on paperwork delays advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 病历已说明 DPOAHC 的生效条件；等待文件会延误倡导。

byChoice.en: Documentation is necessary but does not stop the consult from being placed now.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能阻止会诊现在被安排。

byChoice.en: Ethics consultation may be appropriate if conflict persists, but direct provider communication comes first for the immediate issue.
byChoice.zh: 若冲突持续，伦理会诊可能合适；但对于当前即时问题，应先直接与医师沟通。

byChoice.en: This directly addresses the immediate risk and stays within the nurse's advocacy role.
byChoice.zh: 这直接处理当前风险，并符合护士的倡导职责范围。

testTakingStrategy.en: For 'first action' questions, choose the step that addresses the most immediate threat. Here, the consult order is the immediate threat, so direct provider communication comes before slower support processes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做“第一步行动”题时，选择能处理最即时威胁的步骤。本题中会诊医嘱是即时威胁，因此应先直接与医师沟通，再进行较慢的支持流程。

stem.en: Stage 3: For each finding, indicate whether it shows effective advocacy for Mrs. Ellison's autonomous refusal.
stem.zh: 阶段 3：请判断每项发现是否表明对 Ellison 太太自主拒绝的护理倡导有效。

rows.en: Nursing notes and the palliative-care assessment consistently document her capacity, values-based reasoning, and refusal.
rows.zh: 护理记录和姑息治疗评估均一致记录她有决策能力、基于价值观推理并拒绝 PEG。

rows.en: No PEG consult has been placed over the patient's refusal.
rows.zh: 未在患者拒绝后仍安排 PEG 会诊。

rows.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral are being developed according to her expressed wishes.
rows.zh: 正在根据她表达的意愿制定以舒适为重点的计划并转介临终关怀。

rows.en: Mrs. Ellison says she is glad someone is listening and asks about hospice options at home.
rows.zh: Ellison 太太说很高兴有人在听她说话，并询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。

rows.en: David threatens legal action to obtain a PEG tube placement.
rows.zh: David 威胁采取法律行动以要求放置 PEG 管。

rows.en: The admission albumin and prealbumin values were low.
rows.zh: 入院时白蛋白和前白蛋白数值偏低。

correct.en: Effective advocacy is shown by documentation, alignment of the plan with the patient's goals, absence of an unauthorized PEG consult, and the patient's perception that her voice is being heard. Ongoing family distress and nutritional lab abnormalities may still exist, but they do not mean advocacy has failed.
correct.zh: 倡导有效的证据包括：记录一致、照护计划符合患者目标、未安排未经同意的 PEG 会诊，以及患者感到自己的声音被听见。家属痛苦和营养实验室异常可能仍然存在，但这并不代表倡导失败。

byChoice.en: Consistent documentation protects her decision across the care team.
byChoice.zh: 一致记录有助于整个照护团队持续保护她的决定。

byChoice.en: Not placing the consult over refusal shows the immediate autonomy threat has been contained.
byChoice.zh: 未在拒绝后仍安排会诊，说明即时的自主权威胁已被控制。

byChoice.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral align care with the patient's expressed goals.
byChoice.zh: 以舒适为重点的计划和临终关怀转介符合患者表达的目标。

byChoice.en: The patient's sense of being heard is a meaningful outcome of advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 患者感到被倾听是护理倡导的重要结果。

byChoice.en: A legal threat reflects ongoing family distress, not failure of the nurse's advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 法律威胁反映家属仍有痛苦和冲突，并不代表护士倡导失败。

byChoice.en: Admission nutritional labs describe clinical status and prognosis; they do not measure whether autonomy is being protected.
byChoice.zh: 入院营养指标反映临床状态和预后，但不衡量患者自主权是否被保护。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation should match the goal of the intervention. The goal was not to make everyone agree or normalize labs; it was to protect the patient's informed refusal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果要与干预目标一致。本题目标不是让所有人都同意，也不是让实验室指标正常，而是保护患者的知情拒绝。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。
Client advocacy for a capacitated older adult refusing PEG placement
为有决策能力且拒绝 PEG 置管的老年患者进行护理倡导

An 82-year-old client with end-stage heart failure, progressive dysphagia, and poor oral intake refuses PEG tube placement after an informed discussion. Her adult children pressure the team to proceed, and her son claims authority under a DPOAHC that activates only if she loses decisional capacity.
一名 82 岁患者患有终末期心力衰竭、进行性吞咽困难和进食不足。在充分知情沟通后，她拒绝放置 PEG 管。她的成年子女要求医疗团队继续置管，其儿子声称自己可根据医疗保健持久授权书（DPOAHC）作决定，但该授权仅在患者丧失决策能力时才生效。
Admission record
入院记录

Patient: Margaret Ellison, 82 years old.
Admitted from home with NYHA class IV heart-failure exacerbation, worsening dyspnea, edema, and poor oral intake for 5 days.
History: ischemic cardiomyopathy with EF 15%, CKD stage 4 with baseline creatinine 2.8 mg/dL, type 2 diabetes on basal insulin, progressive dysphagia followed by speech-language pathology for 6 months. Three hospitalizations in the past 4 months for fluid overload. Outpatient palliative-care referral was recently canceled by family.
Advance directive: son David is named durable power of attorney for health care, to be activated only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Current orders: IV furosemide 40 mg every 12 hr, fluid restriction 1,200 mL/day, low-sodium cardiac diet with pureed foods and nectar-thick liquids per speech-language pathology, daily weights, telemetry.
Initial statement to admitting nurse: "I don't want any more tubes or machines. I've had a good life. I want to be comfortable."
Initial assessment: alert, conversational, oriented to person/place/time/situation. Mini-Cog 4/5. Mood calm and reflective; denies depression or hopelessness and states she feels "at peace." Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 92 irregular, BP 104/62, RR 22, SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula. Weight 68.4 kg; documented dry weight 64.2 kg. Bilateral lower-lung crackles, JVD at 45 degrees, 3+ bilateral pitting edema to mid-shin, temporal wasting. Oral mucosa moist. She can manage small sips of nectar-thick water but needs prolonged time to initiate swallowing.
Admission labs: BNP 2,840 pg/mL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 5.1 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 3.2 mg/dL, eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2, glucose 142 mg/dL, albumin 2.6 g/dL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, INR 1.1, prealbumin 11 mg/dL.

因 NYHA IV 级心力衰竭加重从家中入院，过去 5 天出现气促加重、水肿和进食不足。
病史：缺血性心肌病，射血分数 15%；慢性肾病 4 期，基线肌酐 2.8 mg/dL；2 型糖尿病，使用基础胰岛素；进行性吞咽困难，过去 6 个月由言语语言病理科随访。过去 4 个月因液体负荷过多住院 3 次。近期曾转诊门诊姑息治疗，但被家属取消。

现有医嘱：呋塞米 40 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；限液 1,200 mL/日；低钠心脏饮食，按言语语言病理科建议给予糊状食物和花蜜稠液；每日体重；遥测监护。
入院时对护士的表述：“我不想再要任何管子或机器了。我这一生过得很好。我想舒服一点。”

Stage 1: Hospital day 1 afternoon
阶段 1：住院第 1 天下午
PEG discussion and family response
PEG 沟通及家属反应

The attending physician discusses progressive dysphagia and poor nutritional status with the family and recommends PEG tube placement to maintain nutrition and hydration. Mrs. Ellison listens to the explanation and asks, "Will the tube cure my heart?" and "Will I still be able to eat anything by mouth?" She then states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
Physician documentation: "Patient demonstrates understanding of risks and benefits of PEG placement, including that PEG does not necessarily eliminate aspiration risk, and continued weight loss without it. She articulates her values and reasoning clearly. Decision-making capacity intact. Patient declines PEG at this time."
Son David tells the nurse: "She doesn't know what she's saying. She's old and she's giving up. You need to talk some sense into her. I'm her power of attorney — I want the tube placed." Daughter Karen calls and says, "My brother and I agree. We want everything done. She's just scared. Can't you convince her?" The nurse confirms that the advance directive activates the son's authority only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Vitals: HR 88, BP 108/64, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.8 kg. She is resting comfortably, tolerating small amounts of pureed food and nectar-thick liquids. Telemetry: atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular rate.

主治医师与家属讨论患者进行性吞咽困难和营养状况不佳，并建议放置 PEG 管以维持营养和水分。Ellison 太太听完解释后问：“这个管子能治好我的心脏吗？”以及“我以后还能不能吃一点东西？”随后她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”
